items.title: Abbie Williams Interview, 1966-06-02
items.q: And that, you heard of Talker Shottnake, that was Neely Hawking. He had the Imperial Jazz Band.

ctx.x: Well how was Red Toots then? Red Toots, he was good. That's Washington, the guy that lives up in Shrewsbury. Yeah. Yeah, he's back in the union now. He just came back. He and Teddy Johnson just came back. Yeah. I got a little work together, I think. But anyhow, you were saying those guys would hit the floor?

Oh, when they did get high. I mean, at that time around twelve o'clock, they know the dance gonna break up about two o'clock, and everybody got drunk. And that's where they get to battle them up, Monkson. Man, you look there, somebody fighting start there, fighting. Somebody got another catch broad, you know, man, and shake around. And the floor walkers, at that time, we had a lot of bouncers around. And if they catch you cutting up too much, well they put you out, you know. Because that's why they didn't allow…
I can't remember him. What did he play? What happened?
